title: Art. 4.7 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 4 - Entry and Departure of Cargo and Other Articles, A. General, 4.7
content: Where practicable, in order to improve efficiency, modern screening or examination techniques shall be used to facilitate the physical examination of goods to be imported or exported.
